title: File Move Tool — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Transfers files to new locations without leaving duplicates behind. The File Move Tool relocates files and directories to a new location. Within one filesystem it renames atomically; across filesystems it copies, verifies, then deletes the source — so a move never loses data if interrupted. The source is removed only after the destination verifies clean.
capabilities: Atomic rename moves within a filesystem
Copy-verify-delete moves across filesystems
Batch moves with per-file reporting
Collision policies: rename, overwrite, or skip
Rollback of the batch if verification fails
